subject: Human Evolution
title: Projectile Advantage
description: A short lesson to help you apply Projectile Advantage.

hook.text: Neanderthals used thrusting spears. Homo sapiens arrived with thrown spears and eventually bows and arrows.

buildup.text: Projectiles let hunters kill from a distance—reducing injury risk and increasing hunting success rates.

discovery.text: Safer hunting meant fewer deaths per calorie gained—a compounding survival advantage over generations.

twist.text: Neanderthals may have adopted some projectile tech late, but sapiens had millennia of refinement.

climax.text: A technological edge in hunting translated directly into a demographic edge in population survival.

punchline.text: Killing from farther away kept more hunters alive.

quiz.question: How did projectile weapons give Homo sapiens an advantage?
options: They allowed hunting from a safe distance, reducing hunter deaths
